name: spec-author
body: A person or agent with an interest in the durable spec's coherence: they author spec nodes and edges through `apg node add` / `apg edge add` (from inside a project worktree) and read them back through `apg_query`. They rely on one invariant — a single canonical edge vocabulary shared by the write surface and the graph projection. Every edge the write surface accepts is visible in the graph, and a pair the projection deliberately excludes is refused at write time with an actionable error — never accepted and then silently dropped. Their interest is that the two agree on that one vocabulary.
